note: Summary only. The style guide governs voice and sits beneath the Series Bible's Drafting Guidelines (Part Eleven). Read the guide before drafting or revising prose.
tense_status: Chosen by the author for Inheritance (2026-10-08). Tense is set per work; the series style guide leaves it open on purpose for other stories and novellas.
pov_rule: each scene uses the viewpoint in its 'Perspective and goal' field in the scene outline, including the outline's interludes; one viewpoint per scene; the narrator never knows more than the viewpoint character
length_note: No hard word count. Outline lengths are a general guide; long first drafts are fine and get trimmed in revision.
